notes.title: Scarecrow DEMO 2025 Release!
notes.notes:
Hi all! We are pleased to inform you that a new version of the Scarecrow DEMO has been released today!
The demo version can be downloaded for free on Steam. 

Play, enjoy and share your opinion about the demo in the VK group! 
https://vk.com/topic-215651948_53251593
(or you can leave a review in Community Hub on Steam)

Have a nice game!

- ChillouT Studio
